Home.metaTitle: Web, app and online store development
Home.title: I build the website, app or store your business needs
Home.lead: I'm an independent developer. You work directly with me, no middlemen, from the first idea until your project is live and working.
Home.pickerTitle: What is your project built on?
Home.pickerLead: Pick the platform and I'll show you how I can help.
Home.servicesLead: New projects, improvements to what you already have, and rescues for sites that stopped working.

why.title: You talk to the person who codes
why.text: No account managers, no broken telephone: you tell me what you need and I build it.

why.title: Clear price and scope
why.text: Before we start, you know what gets delivered, what it costs and when it's ready.

why.title: The code is yours
why.text: You get the code, the credentials and the documentation. You're never locked in.

why.title: Still here after launch
why.text: Support, updates and improvements whenever you need them.

Home.portfolioLead: Some of the brands I've worked with.

process.title: Conversation
process.text: You tell me about your business and your goals. I tell you honestly what's worth building and what isn't.

process.title: Proposal
process.text: You get the scope, price and schedule in writing, before you pay anything.

process.title: Design
process.text: You review a clickable prototype and we adjust it together before any code.

process.title: Development
process.text: I build in stages and show you progress you can try.

process.title: Launch
process.text: I publish the project, set up the domain, analytics and backups, and show you how to manage it.

process.title: Support
process.text: I keep your project updated and secure, and improve it as your business changes.

Home.ctaText: Tell me what you need and I'll reply within one business day with the next steps.
